Keep the red/tan stern face, long flowing black beard, green cloth headwrap with gold diadem, jade green long robe, ivory cuffs and gold dragon armor of image 1; he is still a human legendary commander, not a giant translucent deity and not a robot. NEW ASCENDED SCENE: Guan Yu stands firmly on the high prow-like command platform above an immense misty river, in a noble low-angle three-quarter pose, one hand raises a dragon command banner and the other calmly commands the floods with an open palm. His ornate newly evolved gold-and-jade scale armor, layered ceremonial green-and-white cape, dragon-shaped shoulder guards and red marquis cord visibly outrank the five-star costume but stay recognizably the same identity. The ceremonial guandao stands beside him, fully contained.

Under its great arc, many tiny intact green-bannered warships move in ordered formation and distant fortified river cities remain protected. Separate bright turquoise water torrents form a grand sweeping command halo, not a mechanical ring. Show tiny soldiers and ships for scale, no bodies. Focus on mastery of river and army-spirit, growing from the original seated water-command picture. Lighting clear storm-cleared daylight, green/turquoise/silver water, rich restrained gold. Preserve identical jade-gold card frame geometry and red 封侯 seal. Keep the head/raised banner/dragon head clear of nameplate and UI.
